seo.title: Invite Billy Ready
seo.description: Request Billy Ready for a church concert, worship service, retreat, revival, conference, or Christ-centered special event.

hero.title: Let’s share the hope of Christ together.
hero.intro: Tell us a little about your church or event. A booking request starts a conversation—it does not create an obligation.

sections.heading: We’d be honored to hear from you.
sections.body: Whether you are planning a worship service, revival, retreat, conference, Christmas celebration, or community outreach, it would be a privilege to partner with you.
sections.contactNote: Phone is currently the quickest direct way to reach Billy Ready Music.
